subject: Change of format: converting intro demo into technical runbook workshop
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Mehta <kate@hearthhome.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@hearthhome.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Change of format: converting intro demo into technical runbook workshop

Hi Kate / Tom —

Thanks again for your time last week. To make the meeting more actionable for your engineering and data platform teams, the execs asked we pivot the intro demo to a technical "runbook" workshop / POC scoping session. Instead of a 30–45 min product overview, we want to walk through your end-to-end flow, validate integration points, and document a tentative scoping checklist so your engineers can hit the ground running.

Quick summary of what we propose:
- 3.5-hour remote workshop (collaborative, hands-on).
- Target outcomes: network checklist, data sample plan, roles & success criteria for a short POC.
- Suggested attendees: 2 engineers from your side + 1 security lead (optional) + product and platform folks.

Proposed time slots (all PT):
- Thu, Dec 17 — 10:00–13:30
- Fri, Dec 18 — 10:00–13:30
- Tue, Dec 22 — 11:00–14:30

I've attached a sample_workshop_agenda.pdf with an outline and prerequisites (network ports, sample data format, temporary credentials). Can you let me know which slot works best and who from your team will join? If none of these work, tell me a couple windows and we will accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to making this practical for your engineers.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0124

Attachment: sample_workshop_agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Tom Becker <tbecker@hearthhome.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Mehta <kate@hearthhome.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Change of format: converting intro demo into technical runbook workshop

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear plan. Good idea to make this hands-on. A couple notes from our side:

- Our CTO and two platform engineers are traveling the week of the 16th; Dec 17 won't work.
- We can do Dec 18 but prefer a half-day window (10:00–14:00 PT is fine).
- Security wants a remote-friendly approach; can you confirm the workshop will not require inbound VPN access from Redwood? We prefer using a shared S3 bucket + ephemeral credentials rather than opening ports.
- Also, procurement has asked for a brief statement of work / scope so they can provision a short purchase order.

If you can do Dec 18 10:00–14:00 PT and send a short SOW + a checklist for the security team, we'll lock it. Otherwise, Dec 22 is also possible if you need the extra time.

Tom
Tom Becker
Director, Platform Engineering
Hearth & Home
tbecker@hearthhome.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Becker <tbecker@hearthhome.com>, Kate Mehta <kate@hearthhome.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Change of format: converting intro demo into technical runbook workshop

Hi Tom / Kate —

Thanks for the quick reply. Happy to run the workshop remotely on Dec 18 10:00–14:00 PT. We commonly run this as a remote hands-on session that avoids inbound VPN by using:
- An S3 bucket for sample data + pre-signed URLs,
- Optional ephemeral credentials for test workloads,
- A shared ephemeral notebook (we can host a container) so your engineers don't need to open inbound ports.

Required from your side ahead of time (we've attached a network-checklist.xlsx):
- Sample dataset (CSV/Parquet) or a small subset (<=100MB) uploaded to S3,
- One platform engineer to be co-present for environment questions,
- Contact for security (we'll include a 15-min pre-call to run through controls).

We'll draft a short SOW that covers objectives, timeline, and success criteria and share it by EOD tomorrow. Proposed agenda (short):
1) 10:00 — 10:20: Introductions & success criteria
2) 10:20 — 11:30: Integration walk-through & sample data ingest
3) 11:30 — 12:15: Live runbook demo (templates + automation)
4) 12:15 — 13:30: Hands-on scoping & next steps (ownership, timelines)

Attachment: network-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

If Dec 18 works, Jasmine will send the calendar invite with the workshop link and the short SOW.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hi Marcus / Jasmine —

Dec 18 10:00–14:00 PT works for us. We'll have two platform engineers and our security lead on the call. We'll upload a small sample dataset to S3 (pre-signed link) and share the S3 path by end of day Monday. Procurement also asked for the short SOW — thanks in advance for sending that.

One ask: please include a short checklist of any firewall rules or allowed egress endpoints your hosted notebook may reach so our security team can review before the workshop.

I'll look out for the calendar invite and SOW.

Thanks,
Kate Mehta
Head of Product Operations
Hearth & Home
kate@hearthhome.com
